title: Today in one sentence
text: The market ended the week near its best level of the year, while a few companies on our list are still well below their highs.

title: AMD caught up with the experts
text: AMD went up about 183% in one year. It now trades at $608, almost exactly what experts expected it to be worth a year from now ($608). When a stock reaches its target early, it needs new good news to keep climbing.

title: Borrowing got more expensive
text: The U.S. government now pays about 5.0% a year to borrow for 10 years, up from about 4.1% a year ago. When safe bonds pay more, some investors move money out of pricey tech stocks.

title: Healthcare had a good Friday
text: Healthcare companies rose about 2.1% on Friday while tech slipped 0.6%. One day is not a trend; we will see if it repeats.

title: Lesson 1: What is beta?
text: Beta tells you how much a stock moves compared with the whole market. A beta of 1 moves like the market. A beta of 2 tends to move twice as much, up and down. NVIDIA has a beta of about 2.2 and Rocket Lab about 2.6, so they are roller coasters. Eli Lilly is about 0.45, a much calmer ride.

title: About the data
text: Expert price targets are available for NVDA, TSM, AMD, GOOGL, AMZN, MSFT, META, LMT and GE. For the others we only use price movements.
